verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say the Postman CLI runs collections from the command line with built-in reporters and can run test collections in a CI/CD pipeline. They also cover combining the Postman API with the CLI for CI/CD, and Newman runs collections from the command line. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, detailed CI configuration docs (e.g. pipeline setup, headless auth, exit-code behavior).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can also use the Postman CLI to run test collections as part of your continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
combine the Postman API with the Postman CLI to integrate Postman with your CI/CD workflow.
Newman allows you to run and test a Postman Collections directly from the command-line.
Run and manage collections with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters.
